The land belonging to the petitioner bearing R.S. No.179/2 measuring 5 acres 2 guntas situated at Herkal Village, Bilagi Taluk along with 353 drumstick standing trees was acquired for the purpose of Upper Krishna Project.

The petitioner gave consent for passing award in respect of the land, and the Special Land Acquisition Officer passed a consent award dated 05.11.1997 determining the compensation payable to the land, and however, deferred the grant of compensation to the standing trees stating that a separate award will be passed.
Thereafter, the Special land Acquisition Officer has passed the consent award dated 06.06.2023 determining the compensation at Rs.1,83,000/- for 353 standing drumstick trees on the acquired land.
Hence, this petition.

The contention of the petitioner is that the petitioner has not given consent for passing a consent award for determining the compensation payable to the standing trees and the compensation amount granted is on the lesser side.
The petitioner has been deprived of his right to claim enhanced compensation.

3. Learned AGA would submit that the Special Land Acquisition Officer after considering the yield Sannaranganagouda S/O Sheshappa Patil vs The State Of Karnataka on 10 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/167547504/
2 of each of the drumstick trees, has rightly determined the compensation, and the compensation awarded is just and proper.

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioner is not entitled for the enhanced compensation.
4. Considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties.
5. Perusal of the consent award dated 05.11.1997 indicated that the compensation was determined for the land acquired.
However, compensation for the standing tree was deferred stating that a separate award will be passed, since the petitioner has not given consent for awarding compensation for standing trees.
Therefore, the Special Land Acquisition Officer was under an obligation to pass a supplementary general award NC: 2024:KHC-D:547 instead of passing a consent award after notifying the petitioner.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The writ petition is allowed.
(ii) The impugned additional consent award dated 06.06.2023 bearing LAQ : SR : 74 : 1995- 96 Part-I passed by the respondent No.4 at Annexure - G is hereby quashed.
(iii) The respondent No.4 to pass supplementary general award in respect of the drumstick trees under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 after notifying the petitioners.
(iv) The said exercise shall be considered within three months from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

Sd/-
